correctness.rationale: For each r>=1 and the precise graph K1 joined to r disjoint K3 blades, the hub-zero local triangle occupation counts 0,1,2,3 update to 0,0,1,3 and hub-one counts update to 0,2,3,3 under strict open-neighbor majority. Counting (z,o,p,q) and hub flips via K=3o+p+2q,L=3o+q,U=3o+2q yields the complete ordered decision table for first entry times and period, with first periodic entry at most four. The proof tracks the orientation of a two-occupied blade under alternating hub flips, ensuring an actual spatial two-cycle, not merely an occupation-cycle. It derives sharp maximum times 1 at r=1, 3 at r=2, 4 at r>=3, all multinomial fixed/two-cycle/basin counts and c_r/5^r -> 1 via a Hoeffding bound. Independent full-state enumeration r=1..4 confirms all first-entry/period categories and total populations; it is not the all-r proof.
